cuts.name: firewall-rule
cuts.stub:
set "REMOTE=%~1"
if "%REMOTE%"=="" (
    echo Usage: firewall_setup.bat ^<allowed network, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24^>
    echo The rule only accepts connections from that network.
    exit /b 1
)
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule ^
    name="MOTRIX ERP Port 666" ^
    dir=in ^
    action=allow ^
    protocol=TCP ^
    localport=666 ^
    remoteip=%REMOTE% ^
    description="MOTRIX ERP Web Application (%REMOTE% only)"
